layers.title: Hab antenna coverage

layers.limitations: Post spacing 1 m; effective resolution of photogrammetric DTMs is coarser than post spacing; features of a few metres may be smoothed. HiRISE DTM artifacts include boxes, CCD seams and faceted low-contrast areas; inspect hillshade before use.
layers.title: Elevation

layers.limitations: Interpretive flags: HARD_HAZARD is team-digitised; LOW_TI is not set (no defensible TI threshold for this AOI, U-03 decided 2026-11-10), so no cell is marked as possible loose fines; TI_UNKNOWN marks missing TI coverage; LOW_RES_DEM identifies cells filled by lower-resolution DEM sources when source mapping is available. Tiles are drawn at the 5 m routing-grid cell size; a cell with several flags shows the colour of the highest-priority one (hard hazard, low thermal inertia, low-resolution DEM, thermal inertia unknown, no data); class values are the flag bit values.
layers.title: Hazard flags

layers.limitations: Post spacing 1 m; effective resolution of photogrammetric DTMs is coarser than post spacing; features of a few metres may be smoothed. HiRISE DTM artifacts include boxes, CCD seams and faceted low-contrast areas; inspect hillshade before use.
layers.title: Hillshade

layers.limitations: The colour COG has about 7.74% greyscale strips in the AOI window (nearest-neighbour sample). JPEG tiles have no alpha: pixels outside the source mask and outside the area of interest are written in the map background colour (04 `void`), not transparent, and the manifest has no coverage polygon. Black pixels the source marks valid are shown as they are; the product page does not say what black means.
layers.title: Orthoimage

layers.limitations: Five POIs curated from NASA Curiosity mission blog posts (drafted 2026-11-09, approved 2026-11-12, BD-14). Positions are the rover's PDS PLACES localized_interp.csv position at the sol of the cited image (a localized solution also present in localized_pos.csv), not surveyed positions of the features. position_uncertainty_m is 0.5, the PLACES SIS 1.3 Rev-A §4.4.1.2 expected accuracy of localized rover positions against the HiRISE base map; it excludes the offset between the rover and the imaged feature. Stop types and ez_theme labels are team framing (assumed); the resource framing of the sulfate contact has no NASA water-yield figure behind it. `engineering` is the team's own stop type: the NASA Exploration Zone sources name scientific and resource ROIs only (docs/ops/exploration-zone.md). Image files are fetched by the pipeline from sources.lock.json (BD-14) and not committed. Vector resolution values of 0 mean not applicable under C5.
layers.title: Points of interest

layers.limitations: Horn slope on 1 m posts; effective DTM resolution is coarser; artifacts possible.
layers.title: Slope

layers.limitations: THEMIS TI has 100 m pixels, approximately 20% absolute accuracy, and gaps where coverage or quality was poor; gaps are unknown, never zero. One TI pixel covers 400 routing cells at 5 m. The cube's ISIS label names no unit; tiu is taken from 02 §C.2 L4 (assumed).
layers.title: Thermal inertia

layers.limitations: Intermediate positions and elevations are interpolated approximations. Localized rover positions have an expected accuracy of 0.5 m against the HiRISE base map (PLACES SIS 1.3 Rev-A section 4.4.1.2). The offset between this traverse and the rover tracks visible in the ortho was not measured in this build; the DEM-to-ortho offset is recorded separately. The cached traverse ends at sol 4868. In the rounded AOI bounding box, the 364 distinct sols from 3571 to 4868 are not continuous. Points are clipped to the AOI plus a 100 m margin.
layers.title: Curiosity traverse
